spec.title: Holevo χ for bit-flip channel, p = 0.1
spec.aria: A flowchart computing the Holevo quantity for a bit-flip channel with p = 0.1: the two entropy terms are −0.3322 and −0.1368, giving H₂(0.1) = 0.469 bits and χ = 0.531 bits per channel use.
